name: NONE
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: No case in any registered command_animation_event_received handler; the id is still recorded in the controller's per-frame event list.

name: PUNCH
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: No case in any registered command_animation_event_received handler; the id is still recorded in the controller's per-frame event list.

name: STOP_L
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: No case in any registered command_animation_event_received handler; the id is still recorded in the controller's per-frame event list.

name: STOP_R
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: No case in any registered command_animation_event_received handler; the id is still recorded in the controller's per-frame event list.

name: IMPACT
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Hit moment: for a non-attack (paired) state, asks the animation partner is_attack_successful and sends it CharacterRoot.command_give_damage; for an attack state runs SetCloseCombatDamageToTarget on the current target, TestImpactOnDynamicObjects and DebugHit.

name: BRANCH
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Combo branch point: fires the next queued attack (FireAttackBasedOnAttackID + InitializeNextAttack) or, with none queued, ends the combo and clears the target and the animation-partner link (then update_animdata_partner_model).

name: LEFT_FOOT_DOWN
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Left footstep: looks up the foot bone (id 0xb), finds the ground material and plays the footstep sound/effect.

name: ANIMATION_DRIVEN
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Sends CharacterRootLogic.command_reset_physics_state to self.

name: TRIGGER_01
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Not handled by CharacterRootLogic. TriggerCharacter (0x87d421) runs a local function once per state.

name: SOUND
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
value_semantics: event data (bool1, entity refs, vectors) select what is played; m_nvalue not read here
effect: Plays the event sound (AnimationEvent.command_play_event_sound / _sound_entity) or, with bool1 set, stops the entity sound and starts a speak line.

name: DISABLE_ROTATION_INPUT
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Sets CharacterRoot data +0xa8 = 1 (rotation input disabled).

name: ENABLE_ROTATION_INPUT
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Sets CharacterRoot data +0xa8 = 0 (rotation input enabled).

name: CAN_GO_TO_MOVEMENT
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Player: PlayerCtrl.command_doing_block_breaker(0); then AnimationLib.SetAnimationEnum(own ctrl, 9, 1).

name: UNUSED
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: No case in any registered command_animation_event_received handler; the id is still recorded in the controller's per-frame event list.

name: CHARGE
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Subtracts rage (add_rage of a negative global), clears the throw target for a player and sends CollisionCapsuleNode.command_state_charge.

name: PRE_IMPACT
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Pre-hit: tells the current target hit is coming (command_hit_soon with damage pose) or makes an AI target block; an AI attacker out of range (1.8 m, 2.2 m if big) drops its target and partner link instead.

name: GRAPPLING_HOOK
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Sends CollisionCapsuleNode.command_goto_grappling_hook.

name: CAMERA
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
value_semantics: not read; the camera event type comes from AnimationEvent.command_get_camera_event_type
effect: Not handled by CharacterRootLogic. CharacterCameraStateManager (0x64b304) maps the camera event type 1..12 to a camera state.

name: LEAVE_ABSOLUTE_MODE
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Capsule leaves StateAbsoluteAnimation for StateOnGround (command_goto_phys_normal_mode) and own slave flag is cleared; if a partner is linked: CharacterRoot.command_leave_slave_mode (dual_end on both capsules) and command_break_joint on the partner capsule.

name: KILL_ANIMATION_PARTNER
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
value_semantics: unused (bool1 = victim dies without the death speak line)
effect: Gives the victim (logic +0x18, else current target) CharacterRoot.command_give_damage of 100000 with a zeroed ragdoll-modifier direction, adds rage/electrify power to self, clears the partner link.

name: DISALLOW_AUTOAIM
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Sets CharacterRoot data +0xb0 = 1.

name: ALLOW_AUTOAIM
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Sets CharacterRoot data +0xb0 = 0.

name: CLEAR_DEADZONE
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Combo timing: sets the attack dead-zone time (logic +0x54), trims the combo list against the combo database and logs the combo.

name: ALLOW_ATTACKS
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Logic +0x60 = 0, +0x54 = -2.0, +0x84 = 1 (attacks allowed again).

name: DISABLE_CHARACTER_COLLISION
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Sets property "enabled" = 0 on the collision capsule.

name: DROP_TARGET_LOCK
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Clears the target lock: root +0x7c = 0, +0x8c = 0, +0x90 = (-10000,-10000,-10000); fires a tutorial event in one case.

name: FORCE_ALLOW_COUNTER_ATTACK
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Logic +0x74 = 1.

name: ABSOLUTE_GOTO_TARGET_POS
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Sets the capsule flag at data +0xb8 to 1: from then on the absolute-animation update re-reads m_vWorldStartPos/m_qWorldStartOrient (or End) every frame and blends from the pose the state was entered in to the track over the blend time.

name: FLASH_GRENADE
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Area attack: effect, game event, hit_soon + give_damage to characters found by a physics query (radius 3).

name: ELECTRIFY_ARMOR
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Same block as FLASH_GRENADE, plus ElectricArmor.command_electric_armor_charge.

name: DISCHARGE_ARMOR
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Electric-armor discharge on the partner: rumble, hit_soon, force_anim_always, give_damage, lightning effect.

name: COUNTER_ATTACK_WEAPON_STEAL
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Partner is forced to drop its weapon and (unless Underboss / type 0) the weapon is picked up by self (WeaponBase.command_do_actual_pickup, root +0xd4).

name: BULLMOVE_IMPACT
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Bull-move hit: give_damage to logic +0x18 if is_attack_successful, camera recoil, tutorial/achievement calls.

name: STEP_AROUND
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Sends CharacterRoot.command_set_stun_time to the locked target (root +0x7c).

name: EXTEND_COMBO_TIME
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
value_semantics: seconds added to the combo window
effect: Logic +0xc = current time + m_nvalue.

name: PICK_UP_WEAPON
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Completes a weapon pick-up: detaches the current weapon, makes the pending one (root +0x15c) current and sends WeaponBase.command_do_actual_pickup; Underboss variant notifies its behaviour.

name: SPEAK
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
value_semantics: not read; enum at +0x20 = speak line, bool1 = stop current speak first
effect: SpeakCtrl.command_add_speak_event_based_on_enum.

name: THROW_BRANCH_POINT
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Throw branch: with a partner in special state 8 fires animation action 0x1e and sends hit_soon both ways; then ClearAttackData.

name: GOT_UP
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Non-player: behaviour.command_got_up.

name: RIGHT_FOOT_DOWN
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Right footstep: same as LEFT_FOOT_DOWN with bone id 0x11.

name: REVERSE_HEADING
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Heading offset root +0x158 = pi, then command_set_move_and_face_heading_to_actual_heading.

name: NO_LONGER_IMMUNE_TO_ATTACK
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Logic +0x84 = 1.

name: RIGHT_FOOT_UP
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: No case in any registered command_animation_event_received handler; the id is still recorded in the controller's per-frame event list.

name: LEFT_FOOT_UP
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: No case in any registered command_animation_event_received handler; the id is still recorded in the controller's per-frame event list.

name: LOOK_AT_TARGET
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
value_semantics: m_nvalue = look-at time (s); second float (+0x28) = second camera parameter; enum (+0x20)==1 adds a force_rotate by pi; bool1 = look at self instead of the target
effect: Player only: camera command_lookat_target_timed{target, m_nvalue, value2}. Camera only; the character is not turned.

name: GRAPGUN_ENABLE
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Sends command_enable to logic +0x24.

name: GRAPGUN_DISABLE
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Sends command_disable to logic +0x24.

name: SET_MOVE_AS_FACEHEADING
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: CharacterRoot.command_hack_set_moveheading_to_faceHeading (copies the face heading into the move-heading fields).

name: NORMAL_HEADING
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Heading offset root +0x158 = 0, then command_set_move_and_face_heading_to_actual_heading.

name: RIGHT_ROTATED_HEADING
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: No case in any registered command_animation_event_received handler; the id is still recorded in the controller's per-frame event list.

name: LEFT_ROTATED_HEADING
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: No case in any registered command_animation_event_received handler; the id is still recorded in the controller's per-frame event list.

name: FACE_HEADING_FORCE_IGNORE
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Root +0xb4 = 1.

name: FACE_HEADING_REMOVE_FORCE_IGNORE
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Root +0xb4 = 0.

name: ROTATE_HEADING_90_LEFT
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Heading offset root +0x158 = +MathLib constant (data +0x40), then command_set_move_and_face_heading_to_actual_heading.

name: ROTATE_HEADING_90_RIGHT
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Heading offset root +0x158 = -MathLib constant, then command_set_move_and_face_heading_to_actual_heading.

name: IMPACT_EFFECTS
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
value_semantics: m_nvalue passed to a local function when bool1 is set; enum (+0x20) = damage pose, selects the rumble strength
effect: Hit cosmetics: rumble, damage effect, recoil (command_do_recoil), partner behaviour command_when_attacked, head animation, particle effect.

name: SAFE_RAGDOLL_COLLISION
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
value_semantics: m_nvalue = third argument (duration) of the physics call
effect: With a partner: PhysicsSimulation.command_set_safe_ragdoll_collision_groups{own visual, partner visual, m_nvalue}.

name: DROP_WEAPON
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: CharacterRoot.command_force_drop_weapon on self.

name: CAMERA_CUT
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
value_semantics: m_nvalue and the further floats/vectors are copied into the camera cut data
effect: Combat camera cut: CameraCtrl.command_set_combat_cut_data, may lock players, hide HUDs and send command_force_step_back to other characters.

name: STARTING_UBER_RAGE
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Uber-rage start: two effects, root +0x13c timer, global flag.

name: CAMERA_CUT_TO_CHARACTER_CAM
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Returns the camera from a combat cut to the character camera.

name: SET_HEADINGS_FROM_ALIGNEMENT
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: CharacterRoot.command_set_move_and_face_heading_to_actual_heading.

name: UNDERBOSS_START_FLAMER
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Underboss phase behaviour: command_flamer_start.

name: UNDERBOSS_STOP_FLAMER
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Underboss phase behaviour: command_flamer_stop.

name: UNDERBOSS_FLAMER_DONE
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Underboss phase behaviour: command_flamer_done.

name: TRIGGER_START_INTERPOLATING
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: In this handler: Underboss phase behaviour command_jump_anim_part_done{event id}.

name: TRIGGER_END_INTERPOLATING
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: In this handler: Underboss phase behaviour command_jump_anim_part_done{event id}.

name: UNDERBOSS_JUMP_OFF_LAND_DONE
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Underboss phase behaviour command_jump_anim_part_done{event id}.

name: MAKE_LIGHTNING_FLASH
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Player with electric armor: two EffectCtrl.command_fire_effect_by_id.

name: THROW_MODE_STORE_TARGET
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Chooses and stores the throw target and its position (root +0x8c, +0x90).

name: UNDERBOSS_WOBBLE_DONE
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Underboss phase behaviour command_jump_anim_part_done{event id}.

name: KNEE
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
value_semantics: not read; enum (+0x20) is the value set
effect: AnimationLib.SetAnimationEnum(own ctrl, 13, enum).

name: RAGDOLL_MODIFIER
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
value_semantics: scale of the ragdoll modifier vector
effect: CharacterVisual data +0x28 = normalised stored direction (logic +0xb8) x m_nvalue.

name: REMOVE_INVERSE_DIRECTION
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Logic +0x34 = 0.

name: DROP_WEAPON_WITH_ANIM
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: If a weapon is held: AnimationLib.FireAnimationAction(own ctrl, 0x1b).

name: FOOT_DOWN_JUMP
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Footstep, jump variant of the sound enum (same block as LEFT_FOOT_DOWN).

name: FOOT_DOWN_STOP
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Footstep, stop variant of the sound enum (same block as LEFT_FOOT_DOWN).

name: LOOP_START
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Not handled by CharacterRootLogic. TriggerCharacter (0x87d421, 0x87e574) stores the event play position when the trigger type is PLAY_POS.

name: LOOP_END
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Not handled by CharacterRootLogic. TriggerCharacter (0x87d421) stores the event play position when the trigger type is PLAY_POS.

name: DO_AUTO_ALIGN
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
value_semantics: m_nvalue -> root +0x270; second float (+0x28) = duration in seconds
effect: CharacterRoot.command_force_auto_align: for the duration StateActive uses m_nvalue in place of root +0xe8 in its auto-align distance logic.

name: UNDERBOSS_SUPPORT_EVENT
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Underboss combat behaviour command_recieve_anim_support_event.

name: RUMBLE
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
value_semantics: m_nvalue and second float (+0x28) = the two rumble parameters; bool1 = third
effect: Player: PlayerCtrl.command_do_rumble_effect.

name: STARTING_HURT_ANIMATION
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Behaviour handler command_dont_move_while_animation_runs{length of the main blend source}.

name: DO_BLOCK_FLASH
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Block flash: logic +0xd8 = 1, removes electrify power, SetTextureSheetData on the electric model.

name: DIE
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: CharacterRoot.command_give_damage of 100000 to self.

name: DELAY_OPPONENT
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Sends command_delay to the current target (root +0x70).

name: FORCE_ALLOW_BREAKOUT
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Logic +0xe0 = 1.

name: FORCE_ALLOW_BREAKOUT_NO_MORE
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Logic +0xe0 = 0.

name: ACTIVATE_DEPTH_OF_FIELD
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
value_semantics: m_nvalue = fade time; entity ref (+0x14) = effect
effect: Player (own or partner): FXGfxEffectCtrl.command_fade_in.

name: DEACTIVATE_DEPTH_OF_FIELD
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: No case in any registered command_animation_event_received handler; the id is still recorded in the controller's per-frame event list.

name: NEVER_USE_THIS_ANIM_AGAIN
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Sets property "enabled" = 0 on the current animation state node.

name: STOP_TWILIGHT_CAM_LOCK
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: If logic +0xe4 is set: StopTwilightLadyCamLock.

name: DO_CHOKE_EFFECT
type_semantics: trigger only (ANIMATION_EVENT_TYPES; consumed by the sender, not by the handler)
effect: Head controller: FireAnimationAction(head ctrl, 2) and SetAnimationEnum(head ctrl, 4, 0x10).
